test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The Election Commission announced the election dates for different states.

options.text: The election dates for different states have been announced by the Election Commission.
The Election Commission has been announced the election dates by the different states.
The election dates for different states were announced by the Election Commission.
The election dates for different states will be announced by the Election Commission

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice sentences, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The tense of the verb is kept consistent. In this case, the past simple tense **"announced"** is changed to "**were announced"** in the passive.
 
• The subject of the active sentence "**The Election Commission**" becomes the agent in the passive sentence, introduced by "**by"**.
 
• The correct structure for the passive form of a past simple sentence is
 
 
• "**subject + was/were + past participle + by + agent".**
 
 

Hence, the correct passive voice is '***The election dates for different states were announced by the Election Commission.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In passive voice construction, the focus shifts from the doer of the action to the action itself or its recipient.
 
• This can be useful for emphasizing the action or for situations where the doer is unknown or less important.
